law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 2297-VI)
applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Lawful basis & consent, purpose limitation, data subject rights, notify Ombudsman of high-risk processing
retention_period: Art. 6(8): kept in identifiable form no longer than necessary for legitimate purposes; further historical/statistical/scientific processing allowed
enforcement_authority: Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights (Ombudsman)
penalties_range: Up to UAH 34000 administrative fine; criminal liability
deceased_data: Not covered per commentary: legal capacity ends at death (Civil Code), so law protects only living persons; relatives' data may be affected (unconfirmed)
research_exemption: No explicit research exemption found; art. 6(8) limits identifiable storage to purposes of collection or further processing; depersonalised data not restricted (art. 2) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Sensitive data: processing of genetic data prohibited (art. 7(1)) unless an art. 7(2) exception applies, e.g. unambiguous consent
notes: GDPR-style bill 8153 passed 1st reading only (Nov 2024); 2010 law still applies
